touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Pennal qualifies as a local detour through Tomen Las Castle Mound and Tomen Las or Domen Las, Castle Mound. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Pennal: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Pennal offers Tomen Las Castle Mound, Tomen Las or Domen Las, Castle Mound, Church of St Peter ad Vincula within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Tomen Las Castle Mound
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Tomen Las Castle Mound and Tomen Las or Domen Las, Castle Mound, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
